title: living-docs theme
description: Colours for light and dark mode, and a logo, for the living-docs report. The reporter checks the file again when the run starts, including that the logo files exist.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file against.

extends.description: The theme to start from: a name (`brand` finds `brand.theme.json`) or a path, relative to this file. Default `default`.

logo.description: Shown in the top left of the header. `null` removes a logo the theme would inherit.

src.description: The image, relative to this file, up to 1 MB. It is embedded in the page.

srcDark.description: A different image for dark mode, relative to this file, up to 1 MB.

alt.description: The text a screen reader announces, usually the organisation’s name.

light.description: Colours for light mode. List only the ones this theme changes; the rest come from the theme it extends.
